summary: Taseko Mines Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting Q1 2026 operational and financial results, including adjusted EBITDA of $93 million, revenue of $237 million, and net income of $17 million. The release details production at Gibraltar (30M lbs copper) and Florence Copper (first cathode production). There is no transaction, activist event, or structural change. As a routine earnings update by a foreign private issuer via Form 6-K, this does not constitute a special situation.
